newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot products up, aided by strong NYMEX close.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot products up, aided by strong NYMEX close.

text.p: U.S. spot refinery products jumped higher Wednesday, helped by the gains in NYMEX prices at the close and continued strength in gasoline differentials.
NYMEX prices surged higher, led by heating oii futures, as traders anticipating draws in the weekly American Petroleum Institute data abandoned short positions.
New York Harbor gasoline differentials took center stage Wednesday, traders said, as sellers lifted offers for prompt barrels about 0.50 cent from the previous day's levels.
Nearby barrels of conventional unleaded M5 were offered at 1.25 cents under NYMEX, though buyers remained reluctant.
U.S. Gulf (USG) nearby conventional M4 gasoline was offered at even with the screen, up slighlty from Tuesday.

Refineries remained active gasoline buyers at the U.S. Gulf, one market player said, and increased action in European gasoline markets mopped up barrels that might otherwise head to the U.S. East Coast.

Some gasoline from the USG is likely to head to the West Coast following the fire at Tosco's Avon, California refinery late Tuesday, traders said. One person there was killed and 25 injured when the 32,000 barrels per day hydrocracking unit exploded.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
